title: KubeCon 2026 - vendor contacts & expense reminders (scratchpad)
content:
KubeCon North America 2026 — vendor contacts & expense reminders (scratchpad)

Purpose: working notes for booth logistics, AV, shipping, vendor invoices, and expense reminders for Redwood attendees. Informal - TODOs + open questions.

Booth details:
- Booth: Hall A, B12 (Redwood Inference)
- Show dates: Apr 11-14, 2026
- Advance warehouse deadline: Apr 2 (must arrive by EOD)

Vendor contacts (quick):
- Freeman (booth shipping & install) — rep: Carlos Mendez — carlos@freeman.com — +1 312-555-0147
  - Quote/estimate ID: 7890. Routing: invoice to finance@redwood.com with PO RF-2026-KC in subject.
- AV Pros (audio/visual) — rep: Jenna Park — jenna.park@avpros.com — +1 206-555-0198
  - On-site tech window: Apr 10 evening. Confirm: 2 wireless mics, 1 lapel, HDMI adapters (2x), laptop input.
- ExpoRentals (furniture) — rep: Lisa Nguyen — lisa@exporentals.com — +1 415-555-0177
  - Delivery window Apr 9-10. Itemize chairs (6), high table (1), literature rack (1).
- CityBites Catering — contact: Mark Li — mark@citybites.co — +1 415-555-0123
  - Lunch order for Apr 12: 3 trays (veg, gf options). Dietary form submitted on Feb 20.
- Local courier (on-site hand carry) — contact: Teresa Gomez — teresa@shipfast.io — +1 619-555-0166
  - Rate estimate for same-day pickup/delivery: $120 flat

Invoice & finance notes:
- AP preference: PDF invoice emailed to ap-team@redwood.com, include PO number in subject.
- If vendor sends paper invoice on site, scan and email same day.
- For reimbursements: itemized receipts required, card swipes alone not sufficient.

Expenses / reimbursement policy (quick):
- Per diem: $60/day (San Diego domestic).
- Reimbursable: flights (coach unless pre-approved), hotel (standard room), ground transport (Uber/taxis), vendor fees, shipping to advance warehouse.
- Non-reimbursable: souvenirs, personal dinners over per diem unless pre-approved.

Submission checklist (for attendees / vendors):
- [ ] Collect all paper receipts from team: Samantha, Jordan, Derek, Alex
- [ ] Confirm each vendor invoice includes Redwood PO RF-2026-KC
- [ ] Upload receipts & vendor invoices to Confluence page (id: 12345678) and tag ap-team
- [ ] Submit consolidated expense report in Expensify by Apr 30 (deadline for Q2 close)

Open questions / TODOs (tracking):
- Do we need extra power drops at booth? (asked infra team — see ENG-4321) — waiting reply
- Who is bringing company card for AV deposit? (Jamie tentatively) — confirm by Mar 5
- Shipping insurance: ops to decide if we insure booth shipment (cost estimate pending from Freeman)
- Confirm hotel rooming list cutoff (Hilton Downtown) — cutoff Mar 20, need final list by Mar 15

Quick timeline (owner):
- Mar 5: confirm on-site card holder and mic counts (owner: Rachel)
- Mar 10: send final PO to Freeman + booth layout PDF (owner: Rachel)
- Apr 2: advance warehouse delivery deadline (ops)
- Apr 12-14: show days — collect receipts daily
- Apr 30: expense reports due

On-site notes & reminders:
- Bring extra HDMI adapters, USB-C -> HDMI, and power strip (2x).
- Label all crates with contact: Rachel Hernandez, +1 619-555-0188.
- Booth contact on-site: Alex Martinez (lead), Samantha Lee (logistics), Jamie Cho (card/responsible for vendor payments).

Links / references:
- Confluence budget page: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=12345678
- Slack discussion: #events-kubecon (https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C03ABCD12)
- Finance ticket for invoice routing: ENG-4321

Notes to self (scratchy):
- if Freeman asks for signature on arrival, have Jamie hold printed PO + layout
- double-check pantry/snacks order with CityBites (gluten-free labels)
- follow up with Jenna about rehearsal slot on Apr 11 morning

End of scratchpad.

(Informal notes, may be copied into a cleaner doc for finance and ops later.)
